Interface Species

All Known Implementing Classes:
ApisMellifera, AttaCephalotes, AustroplatypusIncompertus, Camponotus, CamponotusPennsylvanicus, CustomSpecies, FormicaRufa, KladothripsHarteri, LasiusNiger, LinepithemaHumile, PseudoregmaBambucicola, ReticulitermesFlavipes, SmartAntSpecies, SoldierAntSpecies, SolenopsisInvicta, VespulaGermanica
public interface Species
Interface for species definitions. Each species defines physical characteristics, lifecycle, and behavior parameters.

    • hasMagnetoreception

      default boolean hasMagnetoreception()
      Magnetoreception sensitivity (µT resolution). Used by termites (*Amitermes meridionalis*, *Macrotermes*, *Reticulitermes*) to perceive Earth's geomagnetic field inclination and intensity for mound/gallery orientation.

    • getMagnetoreceptionSensitivity

      default float getMagnetoreceptionSensitivity()

    • getThermoreceptionSensitivity

      default float getThermoreceptionSensitivity()
      Thermoreception (Thermal gradient detection sensitivity in °C / K). Used by subterranean colonies to navigate thermal gradients towards optimal incubation chambers.

    • getGasSensitivityCo2Ppm

      default float getGasSensitivityCo2Ppm()
      Chemoreception / Gas sensing sensitivity (CO2, O2, N2O ppm thresholds). Used to detect hypercapnia (>2.5% CO2) and trigger ventilation shaft excavation.

    • getVisualAcuity

      default float getVisualAcuity()
      Vision / Photoreception properties (Light level detection, compound eye visual acuity).

    • getMinLightLevelThreshold

      default float getMinLightLevelThreshold()

    • hasSubstrateVibrationSensing

      default boolean hasSubstrateVibrationSensing()
      Substrate Vibration Perception (Johnston's organ invalid input: '&' subgenual organ). Used for drumming alarm signals (termites/carpenter ants) invalid input: '&' waggle dance acoustics (honeybees).

    • getVibrationSensitivityDb

      default float getVibrationSensitivityDb()

    • hasHygroreception

      default boolean hasHygroreception()
      Hygroreception (Humidity gradient sensing). Used for brood chamber positioning and avoiding desiccation.

    • getHygroreceptionSensitivityPercent

      default float getHygroreceptionSensitivityPercent()

    • hasElectrosensing

      default boolean hasElectrosensing()
      Electro-reception / Atmospheric Electrostatic Charge Sensing. Used by bees/wasps to sense flower charges invalid input: '&' electrostatic storm building.

    • getElectroceptionSensitivityVolts

      default float getElectroceptionSensitivityVolts()

    • hasPolarizedLightNavigation

      default boolean hasPolarizedLightNavigation()
      Sky UV Polarized Light Navigation (Dorsal Rim Area invalid input: '&' Ocelli). Used by bees, wasps, and desert ants (Cataglyphis) for dead reckoning homing.

    • getWingbeatFrequencyHz

      default float getWingbeatFrequencyHz()
      Asynchronous Wingbeat Frequency (Hz) for flying castes (bees, wasps, alates).

    • hasHoveringCapability

      default boolean hasHoveringCapability()
      Hovering flight capability (Stationary aerial maneuvering for bees invalid input: '&' wasps).

    • getMaxCarryingPayloadRatio

      default float getMaxCarryingPayloadRatio()
      Maximum payload carrying ratio relative to body mass. Ants: ~10x to 50x body mass; Bees: ~0.8x to 1.5x (nectar/pollen crop).

    • getMandibularBitingForceMPa

      default float getMandibularBitingForceMPa()
      Mandibular biting / shearing force (MPa). Wood-cutting termites (~20 MPa), Paper wasps (~15 MPa), Leafcutter ants (~30 MPa).
